title: Power identity for the probability norm
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, let $p>0$, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. For $\|f\|_{p,\pi}=\left(\sum_{x\in\Omega}\pi(x)|f(x)|^p\right)^{1/p}$, one has $|\|f\|_{p,\pi}|^p=\sum_{x\in\Omega}\pi(x)|f(x)|^p$.
